##### Project general facts

Perla 1 at the Bay is a brimming gem at the bay, a signature Italian-designed development. Being the first building in Abu Dhabi with only one elevation, all units have direct sea views embracing the shades of blue. Designed to meet all refined tastes, this high-rise building features duplex apartments and three-story townhouses, each with an equal share of sunshine and sea views, making every moment an exciting experience to look forward to. From high-quality finishing and modern facades to perfectly designed spaces and interior art, every bit of space is well-thought to reflect the very essence of magical Yas Island.

Residents enjoy unparalleled excellence with impeccable services and unrivalled elegance. The rooftop gym and swimming pools for adults and children offer rejuvenation with a sky view, embracing the beauty of blue. Premium hospitality awaits at Hilton Hotel and Viceroy Hotel, while vibrant nightlife comes alive at MAD. Shopping is always special at Yas Mall, the largest shopping center in Abu Dhabi, with international restaurants and shops. Perla 1 offers a lifestyle where luxury, convenience, and excitement converge.

Every residence at Perla 1 features modern facades, balconies, and terraces as per unit plan, kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms with en-suites and guest toilets where applicable, double-glazed windows, satellite master antenna and fibre optic connection for high-speed internet, central air conditioning, vanity units and mirrors, showers with handles and bathtub walk-in showers in each bathroom, and built-in wardrobes in bedrooms. The interiors are designed to reflect sophistication and comfort, making each home a sanctuary of elegance.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Yas South, a perfect opportunity for residence and investment, this exceptional location is Abu Dhabi's premier waterfront destination. Yas Bay is a mixed-use development comprising three main distinct areas: the Waterfront, a vibrant leisure and entertainment district with Hilton Hotel, cafes, restaurants, retail outlets, a boutique cinema, a beach club, and the award-winning Etihad Arena; Residences at Yas Bay, a unique contemporary residential community offering the complete Yas Island lifestyle; and the Media Zone, featuring the new campus for twofour54.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to world-class attractions. Ferrari World, Yas Waterworld, Warner Bros. World, Yas Mall, Etihad Arena, and Yas Beach are all minutes away. Louvre Museum, Al Reem Island, Saadiyat Island, and Dubai are within easy reach. Residents stay in the heart of the action, with everything from theme parks to cultural landmarks at their fingertips.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront elegance, vibrant lifestyle, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Yas Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class entertainment, luxurious amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations.
